residual.guide_tooltip: Notes on every machine, model and ruin
item.residual.speed_upgrade.help: Each halves the ticks an operation takes, from 8 down to 1. A body uses up to %s.
item.residual.stack_upgrade.help: Each doubles the items an operation moves, from 8 up to 64. A body uses up to %s.
item.residual.range_upgrade.help: Each lets it reach 8 blocks further, from 8 out to 48. A body uses up to %s.
item.residual.fluid_upgrade.help: Each doubles the fluid an operation moves, from 250 up to 4,000 mB, and adds 16,000 mB to its tank. A body uses up to %s.
item.residual.energy_upgrade.help: Each quadruples the energy an operation moves, from 1,000 up to 256,000 FE, and holds 800,000 FE more. A body uses up to %s.
item.residual.carry_upgrade.help: Each gives an agent six more slots to carry in, up to 48. A body uses up to %s.
item.residual.lift_upgrade.help: An agent flies while its battery holds out, 10 FE a tick in the air. A body uses %s.
residual.benchmark.forecasting.test: Blocks a Forecaster watched, a line each: a crop's age at every look, from seedling (0) to ripe (7), or a machine's progress through the items it makes, from a (just begun) to h (seven eighths done). Scored by loss on each next look. Even knowing each field and machine exactly leaves about 0.19.
residual.benchmark.recall.test: Eight kinds of goods, each followed by the chest it went into. Then one kind is asked again: which chest?
residual.benchmark.reversal.test: Six waymarks passed on the way out, then the same six named in reverse: the way home.
residual.benchmark.induction.test: Letters in which a run comes round again. Once it does, continue it. Only looking back at what followed the same letter last time works.
residual.benchmark.sorting.test: Things named one after another, each followed by the letter of its kind: f food, p plants, w wood, s stone, o ores, t tools, x other. The test names only things practice never did, some of them made up.
residual.benchmark.orders.test: Orders worded many ways, each followed by what was meant. The test asks for things practice never named, so the model must copy names it has never seen.
residual.benchmark.reading.test: Archive records that no shard carries. Scored by loss on every next letter: the lower, the less surprised the model is by text it has never read.
residual.benchmark.control.test: Melts it has never played, as many of each ore: a letter for the temperature at each look and a digit for the power it chose. A melt is held with 90% of its looks in the band, d or e. Scored by the share held of the ore it holds worst.
residual.benchmark.survey.test: Rows of ground it has never read, a letter for each block, and an ore asked of each: where the first of it lies, a letter from a to p for its place, or - for none. The Surveyor's field notes list the letters.
residual.benchmark.pilot.test: Flights it has never flown, as many of each wind: a letter for the frame's height at each look and a digit for the thrust it chose. Each line starts with the wind as the frame's vane reads it: w down or y up every two looks, x down or z up every three. A flight is held with 90% of its looks at the hold, d or e. Scored by the share held of the wind it does worst.
residual.benchmark.demand.test: Lines of what a Port moved out, a digit a look, in mixes of rhythm and draw it has never practised: what it will move at the next look, from 0 for nothing to 4 for over 256.
residual.benchmark.watch.test: Lines of what a thing did, a digit a look, half of them gone wrong at the end: stopped, run away or slowed. It practises only on things going well, and is judged by how much the last stretch surprises it.
residual.benchmark.retrieval.test: Things named and things asked for, one after another, each followed by the letter of what it is for: l light, f food, m mining, c chopping, d digging, t tilling, k fighting, a armor, b fuel, h building, p planting, s smelting, r storing, w circuits, g travel, q liquids, n writing, y dye, e healing, x nothing it knows. The test names only things practice never did, some of them made up.

residual.access_point.relayed: Through its relays, anywhere they cover.

residual.wireless.untuned: Not tuned. Use it on an Access Point.
residual.wireless.out_of_reach: Out of reach of its network.

residual.storage.search_help: Words a thing's name holds, or a Chinese name's pinyin. @ for a mod, # a tag, $ the tooltip, * the id; - leaves things out, | gives alternatives, ( ) groups; >64, <10 or =1 asks how many. @minecraft ingot -iron finds every ingot but iron. Start with ? to ask the model beside the window for what you mean.
residual.storage.sort_help: Sort by name, by how many, or by mod. Shift-click to reverse.
residual.storage.sort.name: Az
residual.storage.empty: Nothing kept yet. Click the grid with a stack to put it in, or shift-click it in your inventory.
residual.storage.fill_help: Click with a bucket or tank to fill it
residual.search.slot_hint: A model that passes Retrieval. Start a search with ? and it looks for what you mean, among everything kept.
residual.search.no_model: No model in the slot beside the window.
residual.search.not_passed: The model beside the window has not passed Retrieval.
residual.jei.missing: Marked slots are in neither the network nor your inventory.
residual.jei.ask: Ctrl-click to ask the network to make it.
residual.storage.pin_help: Alt-click to pin it to the top
residual.storage.unpin_help: Alt-click to let go of it
residual.craft.click_help: Click to have the network make some
residual.craft.craft_help: Middle-click or Ctrl-click to have the network make more
residual.craft.jobs_help: The crafting jobs running on this network
residual.craft.step_help: Adds this many; with Shift, takes them away
residual.craft.start_help: Starts the job. What is missing, it waits for: put it into the network and the job goes on.
residual.craft.no_jobs: No jobs running. Ask for something the network can make: click it in the grid.
residual.craft.redrawn: An Assembler it needs was given another recipe
residual.port.mode.import.help: Takes everything from the inventory in front of it into the network, 64 items a tick; with a filter, only those kinds.
residual.port.mode.export.help: Puts the kinds its filter names from the network into the inventory in front of it, 64 items a tick.
residual.port.mode.stock.help: Keeps the inventory in front of it holding the number below of each kind its filter names: it tops each one up from the network, and takes any extra back.
residual.port.mode.window.help: Opens the inventory in front of it to the network, which keeps items there and takes them out as if it were a drive. A higher priority is filled first; a filter limits what goes in.
residual.port.filter_hint: Click with a stack to name its kind here, or shift-click it in your inventory; click empty-handed to clear. A filled bucket names its fluid. An empty filter lets everything through. With a filter model, something renamed Food, Plants, Wood, Stone, Ores or Tools stands for that whole kind.
residual.port.model_hint: A checkpoint, or a Relay Card tuned to a Model Server, whose model passes Sorting. It tells what kind each thing is, so a filter slot holding something renamed for a kind imports or exports everything of that kind. A thing it is not sure of counts as other.
residual.port.target_hint: A checkpoint, or a Relay Card tuned to a Model Server, whose model passes Demand. It reads what this Port has moved out and says what it will move next, and a Port that asks has that made first. What it is not sure of, the Port asks for only as it runs short.
residual.port.expects: Expects to move up to %s in the next 40 seconds.
residual.watch.nothing: Nothing to watch yet. It watches machines, crops and agents within 16 blocks.
residual.watch.fine: All is well, as far as it can tell.
residual.watch.wrong: What it did lately surprises its model.
residual.watch.stalled: It has done nothing for two minutes.
residual.watch.told: The Watch Post: something is wrong with %s at %s, %s, %s.
residual.watch.model_hint: A checkpoint, or a Relay Card tuned to a Model Server, whose model passes Watch. It reads each thing's line, and what surprises it is what has gone wrong. Without one, or on a line it cannot follow, the Watch Post only sees what has stopped for two minutes.
residual.port.log_hint: A Field Log here keeps a copy of what this Port moves out, a line per thing. In a Model Core's data slot it is practice for Demand on your own base.
residual.port.link_full: A link on its way is full.
residual.port.craft.on: Asks: when the network and the inventory in front have too little of a thing its filter names, the network's Assemblers and Processors make the rest. Click to stop.
residual.port.craft.off: Does not ask. Click to have the network's Assemblers and Processors make what its filter names whenever there is too little of it.
residual.port.programs.help: Program Cards, upgrades and what its programs hold. With a written card in it, it does what the card says instead of what its mode says.
residual.port.program.run.help: Writes the program on the chosen card and runs it from the top.
residual.port.program.no_card: Put a Program Card in the chosen slot.
residual.port.to_filter.help: Back to its mode, its filter and its filter model.
residual.upgrades.help: Upgrades go here: speed, stack, range, fluid, energy, carrying and lift. A Relay Card tuned to a Model Server lets it reach anywhere the relay network does.
residual.assembler.no_recipe: Draw a recipe in the grid.
residual.assembler.paused: Waits while this screen is open.
residual.assembler.grid_hint: Click with a stack to put its kind in the recipe; click empty-handed to clear. The grid holds pictures, not items: the Assembler takes its ingredients from its network.
residual.processor.ready: Ready. It waits to be asked.
residual.processor.no_machine: Nothing in front of it takes items.
residual.processor.no_pattern: Say what goes in and what comes out.
residual.processor.full: The machine has no room for a round.
residual.processor.in_hint: What the machine takes for one round. Click with a stack to put that many there, right-click for one more; empty-handed, a click clears the cell and a right-click takes one off. The grid holds pictures, not items.
residual.processor.out_hint: What the machine makes in one round. The first thing here is what the network can ask for; the rest come along with it. Click with a stack to put that many there, right-click for one more; empty-handed, a click clears the cell and a right-click takes one off.
residual.hourglass.not_a_block: Only a machine or a crop a Forecaster could run ahead
residual.hourglass.unbound: Bind it first: sneak-use a Forecaster
residual.hourglass.no_forecaster: Its Forecaster is not here or not loaded
residual.hourglass.untrusted.crops: Its Forecaster's model is not trusted with crops yet
residual.hourglass.untrusted.machines: Its Forecaster's model is not trusted with machines yet
residual.hourglass.fastest: Already as fast as an Hourglass runs it
residual.hourglass.short: That takes %s of kept time; it has %s
residual.rod.none: No marks. Use it on blocks to mark them.
residual.rod.full: A rod holds at most %s marks
residual.card.blank: Blank. Use it on an agent to copy its program.
residual.card.help: Use it on an agent to hand this over; sneak-use to copy.
residual.card.unreadable: Not a program it can run.
residual.link.to: Tuned to the Model Server at %s
residual.link.none: Not tuned. Use it on a Model Server.
residual.core.data_hint: Datasets or an Archive Drive for the model to practise on.
residual.core.nothing_loaded: Nothing to practise on. Put datasets, an archive drive or a salvaged model in these slots.
residual.core.nothing_short: Nothing to practise on: see the Data tab.
residual.core.crystal_hint: A checkpoint here takes the trained model when you save. A saved one shows what it can do.
residual.core.tokenizer_hint: A Tokenizer here sets the tokens the model reads and writes. Without one, it reads one character at a time. Changing it reshapes the first and last layers, so they start over.
residual.core.reset_hint: Starts the model over from fresh weights.
residual.core.check_hint: Reads the model's machines again and lists anything wrong with them.
residual.core.speed_hint: Watch slows each step down so you can follow it; Max trains as fast as the Core can.
residual.core.learning_rate_hint: How far each step moves the weights. Too high and the loss jumps about; too low and it barely moves.
residual.core.batch_hint: How many examples each step learns from at once.
residual.core.clip_hint: The longest a step's gradient may be, so one bad batch can't throw the model off course.
residual.icon.cycle: Click for the next, right-click for the one before.
residual.metric.hot_help: Accelerators run hot. One touching water, ice or snow, or in a cold biome, lends a full thread; one with nothing to cool it lends half.
residual.metric.leak_help: Changing later tokens changed earlier predictions. The model can see the token it is meant to predict, so its loss means nothing.
residual.chart.empty: Press Train to draw the loss curve.
residual.tests.held_out: Tests use examples practice never shows.
residual.try.thing_hint: Name a thing, like tin ingot…
residual.try.want_hint: Say what you want, or name a thing…
residual.try.text_hint: Type the start of some text…
residual.try.empty: Ask for an example: a fresh one from the test, answered by the model the way an agent would ask it.
residual.try.example_hint.forecasting: A block's line: a crop's age at every look, or a machine's progress, a to h. The model draws how it goes on.
residual.try.example_hint.recall: Goods and chests, then | and the kind asked for.
residual.try.example_hint.reversal: Waymarks on the way out, then | and the way home.
residual.try.example_hint.induction: Letters where a run comes round again.
residual.try.example_hint.sorting: Name a thing, real or made up, and the model gives its kind: f food, p plants, w wood, s stone, o ores, t tools, x other.
residual.try.example_hint.orders: Type an order the way you'd say it. The model writes what it thinks you meant.
residual.try.example_hint.reading: Type the start of some text. The model writes on, a letter at a time.
residual.try.example_hint.control: Plays a melt with its likeliest choices: each letter the temperature, each digit the power it chose.
residual.try.example_hint.survey: A row of ground and the ore asked for: the model answers where the first of it lies.
residual.try.example_hint.demand: Try a line of digits, like 2000200020002000
residual.try.example_hint.watch: A line from the test, and what the model makes of it by how much it surprises it.
residual.try.example_hint.pilot: Flies with its likeliest choices: each letter the height, each digit the thrust it chose.
residual.try.example_hint.retrieval: Say what you want or name a thing, real or made up; the model gives the letter of what it is for.
residual.sample.control: Held the band at %s%% of its looks.
residual.sample.pilot: Held the frame at %s%% of its looks.
residual.sample.watch.wrong: It says something has gone wrong.
residual.sample.legend: Grey is what the model was shown, white is what it wrote. The bars show its odds for the first token it chose; ⏎ is a line break.
residual.sample.orders.lost: An agent would not know what to do.
residual.sample.orders.confirm: An agent would read it back and run it once you say yes.
residual.sample.orders.program: An agent would make it its program.
residual.sample.orders.now: An agent would do it at once.
residual.sample.sorting.lost: An agent would not know where it goes.
residual.sample.sorting.other: An agent would put it in a chest labelled other, or one with no label.
residual.sample.sorting.chest: An agent would put it in the chest labelled %s.
residual.sample.retrieval.use: A terminal would place it among things for %s.
residual.sample.retrieval.nothing: A terminal would place it among nothing it knows.
residual.sample.unchecked: The model doesn't check out yet: see the Inspect tab.
residual.status.no_data: Add a dataset or drive to practise on.
residual.status.no_crystal: Put a checkpoint in its slot first.
residual.status.reset: Weights reset to fresh random values.
residual.status.changed: A machine changed, so training stopped.
residual.status.issue: 1 problem found: see the Inspect tab.
residual.status.issues: %s problems found: see the Inspect tab.
residual.status.leak: Suspiciously good: it may be reading ahead.
residual.status.budget_used: All %s steps are used. Reset to retry.
residual.status.nan: The loss became NaN. Reset to retry.
residual.status.built: Rebuilt as found. Something in it is wrong.
residual.machine.name: Name
residual.machine.unchecked: Press Check on the Model Core to see what this machine outputs.
residual.machine.unfused: Unfused: one primitive at a time
residual.machine.unfused.why: Fabricated from a salvaged design, this machine runs one primitive at a time and writes out every tensor in between. Same answers, more memory, slower to train. A design you verify on a Bench makes fused ones.
residual.machine.unused: Its output never reaches the Model Core, so it has no effect on the model.
residual.port.stream: Stream: takes outputs in, feeds inputs
residual.lens.stream_end: The end: an input at its front reads the sum
residual.probe.contested: %s outputs drive it at once, and only one may:
residual.job.rest.help: Stand still and wait to be told something. Its program: none.
residual.job.farm.help: Tend the farmland around home: harvest what is ripe, plant what is bare, take the harvest to the chest at home. A rule, so no model is asked. Its program: repeat (farm).
residual.job.store.help: Empty the barrels around home into the chests around home, each kind with its kind. Its model recalls where each kind went (Recall). Its program: repeat (store).
residual.job.haul.help: Walk the six waymarks handed to it on a Survey Rod, load up at the last one and come home. Its model names the way back (Reversal). Its program: repeat (haul).
residual.job.build.help: Carry on the row between the two ends handed to it on a Survey Rod, block by block. Its model says what comes next (Induction). Its program: repeat (build).
residual.job.sort.help: Empty the barrels around home into the chests labelled with each thing's kind. Its filter tells what kind each thing is (Sorting). Its program: repeat (sort).
residual.program.hint: Write a program, like: repeat (harvest, put)
residual.program.help: Steps go between commas, and the Palette lays out every one of them to click together. A program can hold variables, lists, steps of your own and handlers that cut in when something happens; the field notes' Programs page has all of it.
residual.program.run.help: Run this program from the top, from now on.
residual.program.stop.help: Stop where it is. Run starts the program again.
residual.owned.refused: This one's owner keeps it to themselves.
residual.owned.help: It belongs to whoever set it down; only they can change this. Make a team with /residual team make, invite with /residual team invite, join with /residual team join.
residual.team.taken: There is already a team called %s.
residual.program.wide.on: Give the program the whole window, each step on a line. Slots step aside; name things from the palette's last page.
residual.debug.title: Debugger
residual.debug.pause.help: Holds the program at its next step, or lets it go on. Click a line above to stop there each time it comes round.
residual.debug.step.help: Runs one step and holds again.
residual.program.drop.card: Click to load the card's program here; shift-click to write this program onto the card.
residual.program.drop.blank: Click to write this program onto the card.
residual.palette.show: Lay out the pieces of programs, to click together instead of typing.
residual.palette.note: A note to yourself, which does nothing: note first the sand.
residual.palette.go: Walks to a mark the Survey Rod handed it: go 2 is the second.
residual.palette.stay: Stands where it is, for good.
residual.palette.take: Takes a thing from the chests and barrels around home, or the network of a terminal there: take 5 bread, or take bread for a stack. With at, from that place: take 5 bread at 2.
residual.palette.put: Puts what it carries away in the chests and barrels around home, or the network of a terminal there: everything, or put wheat for one thing. With at, into that place: put wheat at 2.
residual.palette.give: Hands you a thing it carries: give 3 bread, or give bread for all of it.
residual.palette.fetch: Takes a thing from the stores, comes over and hands it to you: fetch bread.
residual.palette.pickup: Picks up what lies on the ground around it. With a number, a thing or at, only that: pickup 8 coal at near(4); pickup xp takes orbs and bottles them.
residual.palette.harvest: Harvests every ripe crop on the farmland around home. With at, in that area.
residual.palette.plant: Plants a thing on every bare plot around home: plant wheat seeds. With at, in that area.
residual.palette.till: Turns the grass and dirt around home that water reaches into farmland. With at, in that area.
residual.palette.mine: Mines blocks of a thing around it, nearest first: mine 4 stone. Some blocks need a pickaxe it carries; mine caches takes what the old world left in them.
residual.palette.place: Lays a block on top of a mark: place oak planks 2. With at, in every free place of an area: place stone at box(a, b).
residual.palette.say: Says the words after it, over its head and in chat nearby: say hello.
residual.palette.farm: One round of farming: harvest what is ripe, plant what is bare.
residual.palette.store: One round of storing: its model chooses each chest.
residual.palette.sort: One round of sorting: its filter names each thing's kind.
residual.palette.haul: One round of hauling along its waymarks: its model finds the way back.
residual.palette.build: One round of building: its model chooses each slice.
residual.palette.copy: Copies the build between its first two marks onto the third: its model reads the build first.
residual.palette.move: Moves the build between its first two marks onto the third, contents and all.
residual.palette.craft: Has the network of a terminal around home make a thing, and waits until it is made: craft 8 torch. With what it needs in its hands, it makes it there and then.
residual.palette.supply: Goes after what a job on the network around home lacks: out of the chests and barrels, or mined, and into the network.
residual.palette.forward: Goes that many blocks ahead, one if no number: forward 3.
residual.palette.back: Goes that many blocks back, without turning.
residual.palette.up: Goes up, if it has a lift.
residual.palette.down: Goes down, if it has a lift.
residual.palette.turn: Turns: turn left, turn right, turn around, or turn north. A Port turns its front.
residual.palette.teleport: Jumps to a place the relay network covers, for 10,000 FE: teleport mark(2).
residual.palette.send: Items from one place to another: send 16 coal from front to 2. A body with legs carries them; a Port moves them where it stands.
residual.palette.pump: Fluid from one place to another: pump 1000 water from front to hands. A source block counts, and so does a place to pour it.
residual.palette.charge: Energy from one place to another: charge from box(mark(1), mark(2)) to back.
residual.palette.drop: Drops what it holds on the ground: drop 8 coal at up.
residual.palette.fling: Throws what it holds: fling 8 coal speed 1.5 pitch 30 yaw 0.
residual.palette.void: Destroys what it holds: void 8 cobblestone.
residual.palette.drain: Destroys fluid in its tank: drain 1000 lava.
residual.palette.dig: Breaks blocks: all that pass in an area, or the one in front. dig stone at box(mark(1), mark(2)).
residual.palette.use: Right clicks as a player would, with a thing in hand: use bone meal at front, use shears at entities(4, sheep).
residual.palette.attack: Strikes what stands at a place, or an entity, with what is in its hand: attack at first(nearest(entities(8, mob))).
residual.palette.emit: Gives out a redstone signal, 0 to 15, until told otherwise: emit 15. An agent's stays at its feet.
residual.palette.pulse: A redstone signal for a moment: pulse 15 for 4 ticks.
residual.palette.extrude: Lays a line of blocks out from it, one an operation, as a bridge reaches out: extrude 8 stone at front.
residual.palette.retract: Takes back the line it extruded, the far end first: retract 8 at front.
residual.palette.sign: Writes on a sign, with / between its lines: sign iron / this way at front.
residual.palette.select: The slot its hand is on: select 2.
residual.palette.transfer: Moves from the slot its hand is on to another: transfer 8 to 3.
residual.palette.equip: Puts its hand on a slot holding a thing: equip iron pickaxe.
residual.palette.refuel: Burns fuel it carries to fill its battery: refuel 4 coal.
residual.palette.lift: Takes an entity up on its back: lift at entities(2, sheep).
residual.palette.lower: Sets down what it carries on its back.
residual.palette.provide: Puts up a notice that a place offers things to whoever requests them: provide iron ingot at front.
residual.palette.push: A notice that a place wants things gone, to a request or anywhere that accepts them: push at front.
residual.palette.accept: A notice that a place takes what is pushed: accept at front, or accept coal at front.
residual.palette.request: A notice that a place wants a number of a thing kept: request 64 iron ingot at front.
residual.palette.deliver: One trip: fills the first request a provider can, or takes what is pushed to where it is accepted.
residual.palette.sound: Plays a sound by its name: sound block note block chime.
residual.palette.particle: Shows particles by their name: particle flame at up.
residual.palette.run: Runs what the first written Program Card there says, in its hands if nothing else is named: run at front.
residual.palette.retire: An agent goes back to being an item, and drops what it has. A Port's program stops.
residual.palette.to: Where it takes things to. A list is filled in order.
residual.palette.each: After to: fills a list of places in turn: to each [mark(1), mark(2)].
residual.palette.at: Where it does this: a place, a mark's number, a list, an area or entities.
residual.palette.or_thing: Any of these things: coal or charcoal.
residual.palette.where: Only what passes a check on $it: where durability($it) < 50.
residual.palette.speed: How fast it flies, in blocks a tick, up to 20.
residual.palette.pitch: How far above level it flies, in degrees.
residual.palette.yaw: How far to the side it flies, in degrees.

residual.op.embedding.desc: Looks up a learned row of numbers for each token. Set its width to V and the rows become scores for the next token: a bigram model.
residual.op.position.desc: A learned vector for every position in the context, so later machines know where each token sits. Takes no input.
residual.op.linear.desc: Multiplies every vector by a learned matrix and adds a learned bias: y = xW + b.
residual.op.activation.desc: Bends every number through a nonlinear function. Without one, stacked linear layers collapse into a single layer.
residual.op.add.desc: Adds its two inputs. As a residual connection it lets a layer refine its input instead of replacing it, and gives the gradient a short way back.
residual.op.multiply.desc: Multiplies its two inputs number by number, so one signal can open or close the other.
residual.op.norm.desc: Rescales each vector to a steady size, then applies a learned gain. Keeps deep stacks well-behaved.
residual.op.norm.math.layer:
μ = mean(x),  σ² = mean((x − μ)²)
y = (x − μ)/√(σ² + ε)·γ + β
residual.op.matmul.desc: Multiplies two grids of numbers. With transpose on, it compares every query with every key.
residual.op.scale.desc: Multiplies by a constant. 1/√d stops attention scores from growing with the vector width.
residual.op.causal_mask.desc: Blanks out the scores for later positions, so each token can only look back.
residual.op.causal_mask.math: y[i,j] = x[i,j] where j ≤ i, else −∞
residual.op.softmax.desc: Turns a row of scores into weights that are positive and sum to one.
residual.op.softmax.math:
m = maxⱼ xⱼ
yᵢ = e^(xᵢ − m) / Σⱼ e^(xⱼ − m)
residual.op.split_heads.desc: Cuts each vector into several heads that can attend to different things.
residual.op.merge_heads.desc: Joins the heads back into one vector per position.
residual.op.shift.desc: Delays the sequence by a few steps, so each position sees an earlier token.
residual.op.shift.math: y[t] = x[t − k], zeros before the start
residual.op.concat.desc: Joins two vectors end to end.
residual.op.attention.desc: Multi-head causal self-attention in one machine: queries, keys and values, scores, mask, softmax and the output projection.
residual.op.attention.math:
q, k, v = x·W_q, x·W_k, x·W_v
A = softmax(mask(q·kᵀ/√d_h))
y = (A·v)·W_o
residual.op.mlp.desc: Two linear layers with an activation between them: widen, bend, project back.
residual.op.transformer.desc: One transformer layer: normalize, attend, add back; normalize, feed forward, add back.
residual.op.transformer.math:
x ← x + attention(layernorm₁(x))
x ← x + mlp(layernorm₂(x))

residual.prim.const.desc: A number. Select it to type a new one.
residual.prim.size.desc: The length of the last axis, as a number.
residual.prim.add.desc: a + b, element by element. An axis of size 1 stretches to match the other.
residual.prim.div.desc: a ÷ b, element by element. 0 ÷ 0 is not a number.
residual.prim.max.desc: The larger of a and b, element by element.
residual.prim.exp.desc: eˣ. Past about 88 it overflows to infinity; below about −104 it is 0.
residual.prim.log.desc: The natural logarithm. log 0 is −∞; below 0 it is not a number.
residual.prim.sqrt.desc: The square root. Below 0 it is not a number.
residual.prim.sum.desc: Adds up the last axis, keeping it with size 1: [2, 3] becomes [2, 1].
residual.prim.amax.desc: The largest value along the last axis, kept with size 1.
residual.prim.transpose.desc: Swaps the last two axes: rows become columns. A vector counts as one row.
residual.prim.unsqueeze.desc: Puts an axis of size 1 before the last: [2, 3] becomes [2, 1, 3].
residual.prim.squeeze.desc: Drops a last axis of size 1: [2, 1] becomes [2].
residual.prim.causal.desc: Sets entries above the diagonal to −∞: no position sees the ones after it.
residual.spec.mean.goal: Average along the last axis: one number per row, kept as an axis of size 1.
residual.spec.mean.case.longer.hint: Right for four, wrong for ten? Take the count from the input: size gives it.
residual.spec.mean.case.rows.hint: Each row gets its own mean.
residual.spec.softmax.goal: Turn scores into probabilities along the last axis: all positive, each row summing to 1, higher scores getting more.
residual.spec.softmax.case.large.hint: e¹⁰⁰⁰ is infinite, and ∞ ÷ ∞ is not a number. Subtracting the same amount from every score leaves softmax unchanged.
residual.spec.softmax.case.negative.hint: e⁻¹⁰⁰⁰ is 0, and 0 ÷ 0 is not a number. Shift the scores so the largest is 0.
residual.spec.softmax.case.masked.hint: A score of −∞ must come out as exactly 0.
residual.spec.softmax.case.rows.hint: Each row is its own softmax: reduce along the last axis only.
residual.spec.matmul.goal: Multiply a by b: each entry of the result is a row of a times a column of b, summed.
residual.spec.matmul.case.square.hint: Line every row of a up against every column of b: unsqueeze a, transpose b, then multiply and sum.
residual.spec.matmul.case.tall.hint: The result has a's rows and b's columns: 3×4.
residual.spec.linear.goal: Multiply x by the weights W and add the bias b: the layer every model is mostly made of.
residual.spec.gelu.goal: The activation most transformers use: about x for large x, about 0 for very negative x, and a smooth bend between.
residual.spec.layer_norm.goal: Rescale each row to mean 0 and variance 1, then stretch by gamma and shift by beta. It keeps a deep model's numbers in range.
residual.spec.layer_norm.math:
μ = mean(x)   σ² = mean((x − μ)²)
y = (x − μ) / √(σ² + ε) · γ + β   ε = 0.00001
residual.spec.layer_norm.case.flat.hint: A row of equal numbers has variance 0, and 0 ÷ 0 is not a number. Add ε before the square root.
residual.spec.layer_norm.case.far.hint: mean(x²) − mean(x)² subtracts two huge, nearly equal numbers and loses everything. Center first, then square.
residual.spec.attention.goal: Each position asks a question (q); every earlier one offers a key (k) and a value (v). Each takes the values in proportion to how well their keys answer.
residual.spec.attention.math:
q = xWq   k = xWk   v = xWv
A = softmax(causal(q·kᵀ / √d))
y = (A·v)·Wo
residual.spec.attention.case.three.hint: √d is the width of q, which comes from the input: size gives it.
residual.spec.attention.case.sharp.hint: Big scores overflow a naive softmax; your softmax module handles them.
residual.spec.mlp.goal: Widen each token with a linear layer, bend it with GELU, and project it back: where a transformer does most of its computing.
residual.spec.transformer.goal: Normalize, attend, add back; normalize, feed forward, add back. Stack these and you have the models the archive talks about.
residual.spec.transformer.math:
h = x + attention(layer_norm₁(x))
y = h + mlp(layer_norm₂(h))

fml.menu.mods.info.description.residual:
Rediscover the lost art of building intelligence from scratch.

Someone lived in this world before you and built machines that thought. Find what is left of them, design those machines again from the smallest operations there are, cable them into a real language model, train it on real text with real gradients, and put it to work in the body of an agent.
